result.instructions: Tools for Africa's Talking, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is my Africa's Talking balance?"; "Fetch the incoming SMS on my shortcode since message 0."; "Send an SMS to +254711000000 saying the order is ready (ask me to confirm first).". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Africa's Talking data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run africastalking_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run africastalking_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run africastalking_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. africastalking_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: africastalking_get_balance
tools.title: Get account balance
tools.description: The Africa's Talking app balance (SMS/airtime wallet), e.g. {"balance": "KES 1250.0000"}. The sandbox app has no balance. GET /version1/user.

tools.name: africastalking_fetch_messages
tools.title: Fetch received SMS
tools.description: Fetch incoming SMS received on your shortcodes/numbers, oldest first, in batches (default 25 per call). Pass last_received_id (0 for the first call, then `next_last_received_id` from the previous reply) to move through them; `has_more` stays true while a call returns messages, so keep calling until `count` is 0. Optional shortcode and keyword filters. GET /version1/messaging.

last_received_id.description: Id of the last message already read (default 0 = from the start).

short_code.description: Only messages sent to this shortcode / number.

keyword.description: Only messages that start with this keyword.

limit.description: Most messages to return per call (default 25); `has_more` says if more are waiting.

tools.name: africastalking_send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: WRITE: send one text message to up to 100 phone numbers. Spends account credit and delivers to real phones (the sandbox app only reaches the simulator). Needs confirm=true after the user approved the recipients and text. Returns the vendor's per-recipient status (statusCode 101 = sent), message ids and cost. Never retried. POST /version1/messaging.

message.description: The SMS text (1-1600 characters; long texts are split into several billed parts).

sender_id.description: Approved alphanumeric sender ID, shortcode or long-code number (e.g. +27... in South Africa); omit to use the account default.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly approved this exact send (recipients, text/amount); it spends account credit.

tools.name: africastalking_send_airtime
tools.title: Send airtime
tools.description: WRITE: top up mobile airtime for up to 25 phone numbers. Spends account credit immediately and cannot be reversed. Needs confirm=true after the user approved each number and amount. Amounts are in the given ISO currency (e.g. KES, UGX, TZS). Pass an idempotency_key to make a retry safe. Returns per-number status and requestId (use africastalking_find_airtime_transaction to follow up). POST /version1/airtime/send.

amount.description: Amount of airtime in that currency.

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key (8-100 chars) for this send; the same key makes Africa's Talking ignore a duplicate request.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly approved this exact send (recipients, text/amount); it spends account credit.

tools.name: africastalking_find_airtime_transaction
tools.title: Find airtime transaction
tools.description: Look up an airtime transaction by its transaction id (the requestId / ATPid_... from a send reply): status, amount, destination and discount. GET /query/transaction/find.

tools.name: africastalking_send_mobile_data
tools.title: Send mobile data bundle
tools.description: WRITE: send mobile data bundles to up to 25 phone numbers from your Africa's Talking data wallet. Spends wallet credit and cannot be reversed. Needs confirm=true after the user approved each number and bundle. product_name is your data product (created in the Africa's Talking dashboard). Pass an idempotency_key to make a retry safe. Returns per-number status and transactionId (see africastalking_find_mobile_data_transaction). POST bundles /mobile/data/request.

product_name.description: Name of your mobile data product in the Africa's Talking dashboard.

metadata.description: Optional key-value labels stored with the transaction.

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key (8-100 chars) for this send; the same key makes Africa's Talking ignore a duplicate request.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly approved this exact send (recipients, text/amount); it spends account credit.

tools.name: africastalking_find_mobile_data_transaction
tools.title: Find mobile data transaction
tools.description: Look up a mobile data transaction by its transactionId (from a send reply): status, product, destination and cost. GET bundles /query/transaction/find.

tools.name: africastalking_get_mobile_data_wallet_balance
tools.title: Get mobile data wallet balance
tools.description: The balance of the mobile data wallet, e.g. {"status": "Success", "balance": "KES 500.0000"}. GET bundles /query/wallet/balance.

tools.name: africastalking_make_voice_call
tools.title: Make voice call
tools.description: WRITE: place an outbound voice call from one of your Africa's Talking numbers to up to 10 phone numbers. The call is billed and rings real phones; what is said is decided by the voice callback URL configured for the number in the dashboard. Needs confirm=true after the user approved the numbers. Live apps only (the sandbox has no voice service). Returns a per-number queue status. POST voice /call.

call_from.description: Your Africa's Talking voice number to call from (international format).

client_request_id.description: Optional label passed back to your voice callback URL as clientRequestId.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly approved this exact send (recipients, text/amount); it spends account credit.

tools.name: africastalking_get_voice_queue_status
tools.title: Get voice queue status
tools.description: Number of outbound calls currently queued on each of your voice numbers. Live apps only. POST voice /queueStatus (a read: nothing is changed).

phone_numbers.description: Your Africa's Talking voice numbers to check.
